files.README.md:
# Circuit Inspector

Inspect the current schematic, keep notes in a design or symbol, and try a plugin component library.

- **Left panel:** choose Circuit Inspector for a live summary.
- **Bottom panel:** choose Design notes; notes are saved in the `.dsn` file.
- **Symbol editor:** the Plugin metadata tab stores notes on the symbol definition.
- **Tools / toolbar:** Inspect circuit opens a connectivity report in a main tab.
- **Component library:** choose Example components in the left panel, then place the two-pin component.

This example works in the browser and Electron. No external network service is used.

[Full documentation](docs/README.md)

files.docs/README.md:
# Circuit Inspector documentation

## Inspecting a design

Choose **Circuit Inspector** in the left panel or **Inspect circuit** in the toolbar. The main report includes connectivity generated by TinyCAD.

## Design notes

Choose **Design notes** in the bottom panel, enter text, and click **Save notes**. Save the design normally to write those notes to disk. Use Undo to reverse a notes change.

Notes remain in the file when this plugin is disabled or uninstalled. The Context panel remains available alongside plugin choices.

## Components

Choose **Example components** in the left panel. Place a component to embed its definition in your design. The component remains usable after the plugin is removed.

## Symbol editing

Read [symbol metadata instructions](symbols.md).
files.docs/symbols.md:
# Symbol metadata

Open a component library and edit a symbol. Select the **Plugin metadata** tab alongside Symbol, Pins, and SPICE.

Enter notes and click **Save notes**. Use TinyCAD's library Save button to persist them in the `.tclib` file. Definition notes are separate from per-design notes and placed-instance attributes.

[Documentation contents](README.md)

files.README.md:
# Project Home

Open multiple circuit files and switch between them without sharing undo history or save state.

Choose **Project Home** in the plugin toolbar or View menu. Use **New design**, **Open design**, and each file's Open/Save/Close buttons. You can also choose **Project files** in the left panel.

The application keeps document tabs available if the plugin is disabled. Save All reports failures per file.

[Full documentation](docs/README.md)

files.docs/README.md:
# Project Home documentation

## Multiple documents

Use **New design** to create another schematic. Existing documents remain open. The document tabs let you switch drawings, and each drawing has independent Undo/Redo and dirty state.

## Saving

Use each document's **Save** button or TinyCAD's **Save all** command. File access follows the active TinyCAD target: local files, Google Drive, or Electron files.

Save All reports incomplete saves and leaves unsuccessful documents marked as modified. File saves across several files are not atomic.

## Closing

Closing a modified document asks whether to save or discard its changes. Quitting Electron checks every open document. A browser refresh still requires files to be saved first.

## Startup page

In the plugin manager, choose **Use Project Home as the startup page**. Disable that option to return to the normal editor at startup.

## Scope of this example

This plugin manages open document sessions. Portable `.tcproject` descriptors and directory discovery can be built on top of the document API; they are not part of this example.
